Enter the brave, confessional yet tender world of art icon Tracey Emin in our top rated show. Discover the magical, enigmatic worlds of surrealist painter Remedios Varo and collection highligts in 'Dreams have no title'. Enjoy late autumn vibes in the Sculpture Park and feast on a meal overlooking the sea.

## Current exhibitions

[Tracey Emin 8.10.26 - 18.4.27 One of the most important figures of contemporary art, Tracey Emin continually challenges boundaries and uses the female body as a powerful tool to explore passion, trauma, pain and healing. About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/tracey-emin/) [Remedios Varo 18.9.26 - 10.1.27 Dream worlds and scientific exploration merge with magical thinking in the Spanish-Mexican painter Remedios Varo's fabulous surreal imagery. About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/remedios-varo/) [Dreams have no title 23.10.26 - 17.5.27 A presentation of selected works from the museum's collection, which includes more than 60 artists and spans a wide range of time - almost exactly 100 years - and is distinctive in expression. About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/dreams-have-no-title/) [700 Nimes Road 28.4.26 - 10.1.27 Sparkling jewels and everyday banality: Catherine Opie's incomparable photo series '700 Nimes Road' from the home of star Elizabeth Taylor. Evans' seminal work 'Hyperlinks or It Didn't Happen' examines the consequences of the ever closer fusion between the real and the virtual worlds. About the Exhibition](https://louisiana.dk/en/exhibition/c-b-evans-hyperlinks-or/) [Cleaning the Drapes, photomontage from Martha Roslerr House Beautiful: Bringing the War Home, ca. 1967-72. ## Lots of fun for little artists

Join us in the Children's Wing

Get creative in our free workshops for children and young people. The Lake Garden also offers plenty of space to play hide-and-seek and whizzing down our famous slide. Children under 18 get free entrance to the museum and all workshops are free.

[More on the Children's Wing](https://louisiana.dk/en/museum/childrens-wing/ "More on the Children's Wing")

## Creative explorations

Louisiana Art Workshops are perfect for creative and inspirational outings with your colleagues or partners.

Painting, sculpture, drawing or graphic art... Explore the world of art and its processes together with colleagues and partners. With the help of Louisiana's skilled art facilitators, one of our four thematic Art Workshops gives you the opportunity to engage in dialogue with each other in new, informal and thought-provoking ways.

[For more info and booking](https://louisiana.dk/en/plan-your-visit/for-groups-companies/company-visit/ "For more info and booking")

## A WALK IN THE PARK

Nine signature works outside

In the series 'A Walk in the Park', the museum's director Poul Erik Tøjner guides us to a number of the park's signature works.  

The nine short films in the series range from the pop artist Roy Lichtenstein's yellow brushstrokes over Henry Heerup's granite figures to Alicja Kwade's stone globes and Alexander Calder's three masterpieces in front of the café.

[A Walk in the Park](https://vimeo.com/showcase/8376781 "A Walk in the Park ")

## Sustainability at Louisiana

![](https://louisiana.dk/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/KIM3958.jpg)

With an ambitious strategy that reaches out to 2050, Louisiana has set itself the goal of contributing actively, solution-oriented and inspired to some of the greatest challenges of our time. Working with both short-term and long-term goals, Louisiana's targeted and strategic work with sustainability have been verified by the Science Based Target initiative and has resulted in a Green Attraction certification.
